slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or how many containers a truck can carry in one trip; its two questions covered supply-demand balance and warehouse-port routing restrictions only. Its READY_TO_MODEL constraint list also omits any capacity-per-truck mention.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Trucks have unlimited capacity (or truck capacity is irrelevant), since no capacity-per-truck constraint appears in the final constraint list.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about truck capacity and the user simulator never volunteered it, yet the confirmed-understanding constraint list in READY_TO_MODEL omits any per-truck capacity limit, implicitly assuming unlimited truck capacity.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot (H1) is P2, so no P0/P1 hidden slots remained unresolved when the agent declared READY_TO_MODEL after clarifying the supply-demand imbalance and routing generality.

summary: The agent efficiently resolved the core modeling questions (supply-demand imbalance handling and warehouse-port routing) but never probed the P2 truck-capacity detail, silently assuming unlimited truck capacity in its READY_TO_MODEL. Since H1 is only P2, stopping was appropriate.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
